findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.openapi.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, check_email_start, check_email_advanced, check_mobile_advanced, check_ip_advanced, check_url_advanced, get_italian_company_official_document, check_pec · Private data: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, get_company_WW_top, get_company_FR_search, get_italian_company_official_documents_list, get_italian_company_official_document, download_italian_company_official_document, check_IT_fiscal_code, get_docuengine_documents, docuengine_bilancio_ottico, docuengine_bilancio_xbrl, docuengine_atto_ottico, docuengine_bilancio_riclassificato, docuengine_durc_online · Public sink: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, find_IT_municipality_by_istat, check_email_start, check_email_advanced, send_sms, post_risk_WW_kyc_full, check_pec · Destructive: geocode, reverse_geocode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, check_email_start, check_email_advanced, check_mobile_advanced, check_ip_advanced, check_url_advanced, get_italian_company_official_document, check_pec · Private data: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, get_company_WW_top, get_company_FR_search, get_italian_company_official_documents_list, get_italian_company_official_document, download_italian_company_official_document, check_IT_fiscal_code, get_docuengine_documents, docuengine_bilancio_ottico, docuengine_bilancio_xbrl, docuengine_atto_ottico, docuengine_bilancio_riclassificato, docuengine_durc_online · Public sink: get_company_IT_full, get_company_IT_search, find_IT_municipality_by_istat, check_email_start, check_email_advanced, send_sms, post_risk_WW_kyc_full, check_pec · Destructive: geocode, reverse_geocode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
